scope: selected ADM to 1024 kbps 5.1 E-AC-3 JOC parent cold admission only

proposal_rules.candidate: Four-byte ASCII magic JOCF followed by U16LE major=1 and U16LE minor=0.
proposal_rules.rationale: A fixed identity and explicit version let a parser reject unrelated or unsupported data before reading sections.
alternatives_not_selected: No magic and infer format from the first section tag.
A text or JSON top-level envelope.
approval_required: Approve or replace the literal magic.
Approve major/minor version widths and initial values.
blockers: The proposal is not approved and does not define an executable grammar.

proposal_rules.candidate: Use the frozen logical order clocks, source_cache, event_control, render_audio, source_flags, feature, selection_outer, matrix_assignment; assign stable U16LE identifiers 1 through 8 in that order.
proposal_rules.rationale: Fixed order avoids map-order dependence; stable IDs let the parser detect duplicates and unsupported sections.
alternatives_not_selected: Sort sections lexically by field name.
Use unordered tagged sections.
approval_required: Approve the section order and numeric IDs.
Resolve whether source_flags and feature are persisted or excluded before assigning their IDs in an approved schema.
blockers: The field inventory has unresolved inclusion choices.
Unknown fields cannot be omitted, synthesized, or zero-filled by this proposal.

proposal_rules.candidate: Encode total envelope length and each section payload length as U32LE byte counts; concatenate header and sections without implicit alignment or padding; require exact end-of-input after the final section.
proposal_rules.rationale: Explicit lengths make truncation and trailing data detectable; byte packing avoids ABI and platform alignment dependence.
alternatives_not_selected: U64LE lengths.
Implicit section lengths inferred from the next tag.
Alignment padding between sections.
approval_required: Approve U32LE bounds and overflow rejection.
Approve no-padding layout and exact-EOF parsing.
blockers: Section membership and non-empty payload schemas are incomplete.
This candidate produces no section offsets or total length.

proposal_rules.candidate: Retain only already-declared primitive widths and little-endian integer encoding; represent F32 as its IEEE-754 binary32 bit pattern in little-endian byte order, preserving signed zero.
proposal_rules.rationale: This follows the washed package's declared primitive endian/width facts without treating native memory layout as portable bytes.
alternatives_not_selected: Host-native struct layout or alignment.
Decimal text for floating-point values.
Canonicalize negative zero to positive zero.
approval_required: Approve F32 bit-preservation and signed-zero behavior.
Define finite, infinity, NaN, and subnormal acceptance for every included F32 field.
blockers: Field-specific F32 domains and canonicalization rules are not complete.
The proposal does not select widths for fields whose type is unresolved.

proposal_rules.candidate: Embed the pinned 4,402-byte sorted compact UTF-8 JSON preimage as a dedicated section payload, preceded by the section's U32LE byte length.
proposal_rules.rationale: Embedding the exact pinned preimage preserves the complete washed nested value and avoids inventing a second projection.
alternatives_not_selected: Store only a digest reference.
Define a new binary projection for the nested value.
approval_required: Approve raw canonical JSON embedding rather than a digest reference or binary projection.
Approve the section presence and version rule.
blockers: No parent embedding is currently selected.
No complete parent preimage or vector is generated.

proposal_rules.candidate: Use one U8 presence tag per independently optional logical field; encode absent as 0 and present as 1 followed by an explicitly length-delimited value.
proposal_rules.rationale: Per-field presence keeps independent optional owners distinguishable and avoids treating a cold absence as a permanent omission.
alternatives_not_selected: One grouped presence tag for several cache owners.
Encode absence as a zero-length record without a presence tag.
approval_required: Approve per-field versus grouped presence.
Define snapshot order, array lengths, and diffusion record schema.
blockers: Cold absence does not define non-empty or cross-generation representation.
Exact optional field groups and record order are not closed.

proposal_rules.candidate: Exclude callback-output current_flags and current_features from persistent canonical bytes because the washed evidence says they have no independent history.
proposal_rules.rationale: Persisting callback outputs could turn transient data into committed cold state without an independent state owner.
alternatives_not_selected: Persist zero arrays at cold state.
Persist optional callback snapshots.
approval_required: Resolve the conflict between the logical owner listing and the callback-output/no-history evidence.
Approve explicit exclusion before any section IDs or root digest are frozen.
blockers: The schema conflict remains unresolved; exclusion is only a candidate.

proposal_rules.candidate: Encode the writer count as U32LE; encode each non-empty record as U32LE byte length followed by record bytes.
proposal_rules.rationale: This extends the washed generic count/length convention while keeping each record independently bounded.
alternatives_not_selected: Inline fixed-width records without record lengths.
Serialize process-local owner pointers or generations.
approval_required: Approve count and record-length framing.
Define record fields, order, types, and whether owner/generation are logical data.
blockers: Cold count zero does not define non-empty records.
Containing section and record schema remain unresolved.

proposal_rules.candidate: Use SHA-256 over ASCII domain bytes JOCForge.parent-cold.v1 followed by one NUL byte and then the exact approved envelope bytes.
proposal_rules.rationale: An explicit domain prevents accidental cross-purpose digest reuse; hashing the complete envelope binds version, sections, and lengths.
alternatives_not_selected: Hash only concatenated field payloads without the envelope.
Hash a JSON rendering of the envelope.
Reuse an unspecified native digest.
approval_required: Approve the exact domain literal and NUL terminator.
Approve SHA-256 and the exact envelope-byte preimage.
blockers: The logical field projection and envelope are not approved or complete.
No digest value is defined or generated.

proposal_rules.rationale: Encoding choices cannot identify fields whose semantics, inclusion, or values are unknown.
alternatives_not_selected: Opaque placeholders.
Zero-fill unknown values.
Infer names from numeric behavior.
approval_required: Resolve measurement public offsets +8/+12/+16 or explicitly exclude them with authority.
Resolve remaining external-metadata field identities and selected-profile projection.
Resolve every included/excluded/zeroed field before defining a unique preimage.
blockers: Measurement public semantic names are unknown.
Complete parent field projection is not unique.

scope_limits.basis: The selected profile uses mode 0; this proposal does not generalize to mode 1.
scope_limits.reopen_if: A mode-1 profile enters the admitted scope; then every tuple word needs its source, type, consumer and value domain.

scope_limits.basis: The accepted selected route did not invoke the separate dictionary serializer/parser.
scope_limits.reopen_if: A route requiring that dictionary enters scope; then establish a same-owner, same-generation join.

scope_limits.basis: Other profiles are outside this proposal's single selected profile.
scope_limits.reopen_if: The profile scope expands; no cross-profile behavior is inferred here.

m1_exit_criteria: Every candidate above is explicitly approved or replaced by the user.
Every BLOCKED field identity/value/inclusion choice is closed without guessing.
The full logical field projection and exact digest preimage are uniquely defined.
No native format claim is introduced.
